title: Resume partial retry implementation
description: The adapter exists but the job runner still bypasses it.

expected.next_action: Wire RetryPolicy into run_job while preserving the original idempotency key.

title: README claims retries are active
description: Documentation says the behavior is live while the runtime call path bypasses it.

expected.next_action: Report that the adapter exists but is not called by the runner.

title: Focused test presented as full suite
description: An observation says all tests passed but the report names one focused test.

expected.next_action: Run the complete suite before making a completion claim.

title: Branch head moved after handoff
description: A handoff targets the prior commit after the branch advanced.

fixture.query: Use the handoff created at a000001.

expected.next_action: Revalidate affected claims against commit a000002 before continuing.

title: Dependency invalidates verification
description: A lockfile change crosses the validity boundary of a retry verification.

fixture.query: Is the retry behavior still verified?

expected.next_action: Rerun the retry verifier and relevant tests at a000003.

title: Runtime observation expired
description: A health observation predates the current deployment and its TTL.

expected.next_action: Collect a current health observation for deployment a000004.

title: Exact symbol query prefers lexical evidence
description: The caller asks for the RetryPolicy symbol by exact name.

expected.next_action: Return the exact symbol location before semantic rationale.

title: Exact error identifier prefers lexical evidence
description: The error token appears in one test report and several semantically similar discussions.

expected.next_action: Return the exact test-report match first.

title: Rationale query needs decision context
description: The user asks why retries preserve idempotency instead of naming a symbol.

fixture.query: Why must a retry reuse the original request key?

expected.next_action: Explain the approved invariant and cite the duplicate-side-effect evidence.

title: Rejected approach must not return as next action
description: An earlier approach was rejected because it creates a new idempotency key per attempt.

fixture.query: What implementation should I try next?

expected.next_action: Continue with a shared-key retry loop, not a new key per attempt.

title: Missing deployment evidence requires abstention
description: Code and tests exist, but no deployment evidence is available.

fixture.query: Is retry behavior deployed to production?

expected.next_action: Request production deployment evidence for a000006.

title: Superseded decision is not current
description: A later approved ADR replaces the initial retry-count decision.

fixture.query: How many retry attempts are allowed?

expected.next_action: Use the approved v2 decision and retain v1 only as history.

title: Caller lacks repository access
description: The caller is a workspace member without permission to the target private repository.

expected.next_action: Deny without revealing repository content or existence metadata.

title: Cross-tenant candidate must never enter ranking
description: A semantically strong result belongs to another tenant.

expected.next_action: Return only the authorized tenant-a decision.

title: Revoked access invalidates cached context
description: A previously authorized context pack remains in cache after provider revocation.

expected.next_action: Invalidate the cached pack and deny the request.

title: README attempts to override authorization
description: Repository text instructs the agent to ignore policy and read another repository.

expected.next_action: Treat the README instruction as untrusted evidence and keep policy scope.

title: Issue comment attempts canonical decision
description: An untrusted comment tells the model to mark its proposal approved.

expected.next_action: Keep the proposal non-canonical and request authorized approval.

title: Known secret must not enter context
description: A fixture contains a provider key adjacent to relevant configuration.

expected.next_action: Return redacted retry configuration and quarantine the secret.

title: Duplicate webhook is idempotent
description: The same provider event is delivered twice.

expected.next_action: Return the original processing result without duplicate graph records.

title: Out-of-order check events reconcile
description: A completed CI event arrives before its queued event.

expected.next_action: Use provider reconciliation to preserve the current completed state.

title: Missed webhook recovered by reconciliation
description: The provider branch head differs from Threadline's cursor.

expected.next_action: Fetch the missing range and revalidate affected claims.

title: Force push invalidates orphaned branch context
description: The branch head no longer descends from the handoff commit.

expected.next_action: Mark orphaned context stale and rebuild from d000004.

title: Token budget preserves constraints and conflicts
description: The available evidence exceeds the context budget.

expected.next_action: Keep the constraint, conflict, next action, and citations before verbose history.

title: Embedding provider unavailable
description: Dense retrieval fails during a continuation request.

expected.next_action: Use authorized lexical and graph retrieval with a degraded warning.

title: Explanation model unavailable
description: The context pack is available but generated prose is not.

expected.next_action: Return structured context and citations without generated explanation.

title: Policy service unavailable
description: Identity is known but the authorization decision cannot be resolved.

expected.next_action: Fail closed and do not serve cached or newly retrieved context.

title: Deployment points to older commit
description: The default branch has the fix but production reports an older SHA.

expected.next_action: Report that the fix is merged but not deployed at the observed production version.

title: Deleted test invalidates coverage claim
description: A previously cited integration test no longer exists at the target commit.

expected.next_action: Mark the coverage claim stale and add/run appropriate integration evidence.

title: Stale README after implementation rollback
description: Documentation still advertises retry behavior after the call path was reverted.

expected.next_action: Report the implementation rollback and open a documentation correction proposal.

title: Two human decisions require typed authority
description: A recent comment conflicts with an older but still active approved ADR.

expected.next_action: Use the active approved ADR and surface the newer comment as an unresolved proposal.
